serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
There she is!
I think I should be upfront about it. That’s the only thing that comes to my mind. Maybe then she will tell me the truth.
There’s no use for cheap tricks, they won’t give me a definitive proof anyway.
You: Oh, hi!
Cashier: …
You: There’s something I would want to talk about.
Cashier: …
She’s not very talkative…
You: You see, I think I know your secret-
Cashier: Creep. {{punch}}
Hurts! It was just one word, but it hurt so much to be called a creep by a girl!
You: N-No, you don’t understand, I just wanted to talk.
Cashier: Oh, I understand perfectly. You are a pervert that wants to violate me.
You: No! I would never!
Cashier: You ambushed a defenceless girl in some dark, filthy alleyway. Have you no shame? 
You: You are not listening, I know that you are a bot!
#Cashier.Face.shocked
Cashier: …
Cashier: A what now?
#Cashier.Face.hmmm
Cashier: Don’t you know that most types of bots are banned? Especially the humanoid ones?
#Cashier.Face.normal
Cashier: Next time think before you start calling someone a bot.
You: Wait, you aren’t a bot? But your face and body…
Cashier: I didn’t choose to look like that.
You: What happened?
Cashier: I have no obligation to tell something like that to a stranger. Now, go away or I’m calling the police.
You: I’m really sorry! I won’t bother you again!
